# Is this tender ready for your attention?

> Paste a public tender and get a fast bid-readiness checklist for deadlines, bonds, insurance, certifications, questions, and submission instructions. Runs privately in your browser.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are keyword matches in the text pasted in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

A signal the text appears to waive ("A bid bond is not required") is shown as "Stated as not required". The waiver is read in the clause holding the keyword, and a clause that both requires and waives counts as found.
